## Who

Debarjun Thakur is a Frontend Developer and AI Systems Builder based in West
Bengal, India. He is the primary frontend engineer for Raen AI's web
properties, and he also ships freelance web/software projects for businesses
and NGOs. His specialties: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS,
technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, web performance, LLM tooling (Groq, LLaMA,
LangChain, RAG, LoRA fine-tuning), REST APIs, MongoDB, and Node.js.

## Experience

- **Frontend Developer @ Raen AI** — May 2024 to present. Owns technical SEO,
  performance, semantic structure, and responsive delivery. Drove brand SEO to
  the #1 Google result. Led the GarageView CRM frontend through production.
- **Freelance Software Developer** — 2023 to May 2024. Delivered end-to-end web
  and software projects for businesses and NGOs.
